title: Parser for the .michi file format
body: Three passes: parse to an untyped tree, expand sweeps, lower to builder calls. Rules in docs/file-format.md. Load-time errors with file, line and the sweep binding.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: Decided 2026-10-08: hand-written lexer and recursive descent, zero dependencies. Passes: parse, resolve (data and ranges), expand (sweeps, labels), lower (builders, typing). Reserved words listed in docs/file-format.md. First error stops. Golden .sh files test parse and resolve; expand gets unit tests.
